summary: std::atomic provides atomic class template and specializations for bool, integral, floating-point (C++20), and pointer types. Each atomic operation is indivisible with regards to any other atomic operation involving the same object. Atomic objects are free of data races.
cpp17_notes: std::atomic is fully available in C++17. Memory ordering semantics unchanged. C++20 adds floating-point atomic specializations and atomic_ref.
audio_thread_notes: std::atomic<T> is safe for real-time audio when T fits in the hardware's atomic word size (typically pointer-sized). Use is_always_lock_free to verify. Prefer acquire/release memory ordering over seq_cst for better performance.
